LF-011.title: Fridge magnet
LF-011.text: POP. 913. A town that never updates its sign.

LF-015.title: Cal's notebook
LF-015.text: "M. Pell. Dentist. Friend. Do not let her go."

LF-018.title: Priya's voicemail
LF-018.text: "Don't go before Thursday. Please. I think I found the pattern."

LF-019.title: The Match List
LF-019.text: Eleven names, each ticked. Mags had been matching her patients to a dead man's charts.

LF-021.title: One-way ticket
LF-021.text: The 6:40 launch. Not for today. For tomorrow.

LF-043.title: Casimir's ledger
LF-043.text: 9 Sept 1961. "A. Marsh, 9. Extraction, lower left. Paid in eggs." The last entry.

LF-055.title: Chart: T. Rook, 1958
LF-055.text: A gold crown and two fillings, each stamped CP.

LF-056.title: Overlay: Silas = Rook
LF-056.text: The X-ray of Silas's mouth carries Rook's work, mark for mark.

LF-071.title: Appointment book
LF-071.text: Eight patients, written in a hand that is almost Mags's.

LF-074.title: A second hand
LF-074.text: Someone has been correcting Cal's notebook in the margins.

LF-014.title: Daniel's voicemail
LF-014.text: "Don't make me find a new fish guy." He doesn't mean it. He sounds like a man who can't say what he means.

LF-023.title: Lux's unsent note
LF-023.text: "Go, you idiot." Crossed out. Then: "Stay." Crossed out. Then nothing.

LF-024.title: Salt Cathedral contract
LF-024.text: A touring slot. Signed at 11:58 p.m. Jo had not told anyone.

LF-025.title: "JO IS A DRAGON"
LF-025.text: A crayon drawing by Tobi. Beside the dragon, a smaller figure, a girl, blue, drawn with a wet-looking line.

LF-047.title: Gid's drum chart: Mercy Roll
LF-047.text: A 1961 snare chart in a boy's pencil. A long roll, then a pause, then the same roll. The tape box has a second sheet: someone has numbered the strokes. 212.

LF-052.title: Amos's Santa letter
LF-052.text: "Dear Santa, I do not want anything. I want to stay in Mercy." Age 9. 1960.

LF-057.title: The Prompt Book, p.1
LF-057.text: A prompt book from the Playhouse. 1962. Margins full of tiny pencil notes: CAST CHANGE. U/S. 'Seat them all.' The handwriting is a child's, then a woman's, then the same woman's, older.

LF-075.title: Tobi's Fact 31
LF-075.text: "FACT 31: Auntie Nell never gets wet when it rains."

LF-066.title: "Heart failure. Again."
LF-066.text: Adaeze, reading a death certificate aloud in a flat voice. The fourth this year.

LF-072.title: The Lady with Wet Hands
LF-072.text: A fourth-grader's drawing, one of eight years' worth. The same figure every time, rising out of the lake.

LF-032.title: Council minutes
LF-032.text: "Nothing to report." The same two words, atop sixty-three years of minutes.

LF-073.title: Fitz's slip
LF-073.text: "Ambrose... no. That's... who's Ambrose?" He said it to the glass he was drying.
